Do you charge for a quote?
No. For anything bigger than a tap we come and look, and that visit costs nothing.
Are you insured?
Public liability and Gas Safe registration, both current. Ask and we will send the certificates.
How soon can you come?
Emergencies the same day, nearly always. Booked work is usually within the week.
